sentences.en: That famous poet planned on killing himself in his library.
sentences.zh: 那位著名的诗人打算在他自己的图书馆里自杀。

sentences.en: Tell us what you've got planned for your big day.
sentences.zh: 告诉我们你为你的大日子有什么计划。

sentences.en: I planned to become a teacher, but I never did.
sentences.zh: 我本来打算成为一名教师，但最终没有实现。

senses.zh: 计划了的，根据计划的v.计划，打算，设计( plan的过去式和过去分词 )
